headline: Hawai'i Hilo alone unbeaten in a losing conference
dek: Hawai'i Hilo have won all three of their matches and conceded a single goal, with both of their meetings with fellow members among the wins. No other programme has won as often, and every other side in the conference has already lost at least once.
displaced_by: Vanguard's draw at Cal Poly Pomona; the standing dek said they had no point

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Concordia Irvine's nine goals have come from eight different scorers, a spread matched only by Dominican (Calif.), though they have conceded six in reaching the top of the chart.

wire.line: Concordia Irvine have scored nine goals, more than Biola, Chaminade, Jessup and Vanguard together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fifteen matches dated before the end of August carry no published result, most of them preseason dates against non-collegiate or junior-college opponents; there are no score gaps.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Vanguard's draw with Cal Poly Pomona was their first point of the season; they have conceded twelve goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Biola scored for the first time this season at Colorado Christian, two goals from two different scorers, and remain without a win after two draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Robert Ronco has scored both of Vanguard's two goals, from ten shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made nineteen saves for Westmont at a save percentage of .760.

last_match.line: Concordia Irvine had drawn at Colorado Christian earlier in the week; Colorado School of Mines had held Biola to a goalless draw on the same ground.

next_match.line: Chaminade have yet to win; UT Dallas lost at Hawai'i Hilo and then won at Hawai'i Pacific on this tour.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
